freePlan.limits: Unlimited free events at no cost; fees only apply to paid tickets

keyLimits.en: Unlimited free events, no platform fee
Up to 10,000 daily emails; available only in US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, Ireland
Includes strategic advisor, sponsored marketing, priority support

cautions.en: Paid tickets carry a per-ticket service fee of 3.7% + $1.79, plus a 2.9% payment processing fee; these are separate from the free/Pro plan cost and can be passed to attendees.
Eventbrite Ads and ad spend are billed separately from the platform fees and are only available in select markets.

capabilities.en: AI-powered event page creation with multiple ticket types, reserved seating and timed entry
Email marketing automation and social media ad tools (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)
Mobile check-in app and secure payment processing with pre-event payouts

limitations.en: Eventbrite Ads and the Pro email marketing add-on are only available in a handful of markets (US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, Ireland)
Per-ticket service and processing fees apply to every paid ticket regardless of plan, with no flat-fee alternative
